title: Certify and execute equation stage layout

progress.summary: All four fold presentation modes now have browser proof that they preserve one semantic transition/checkpoint set, one accessible MathML owner, one certified stage mechanism, and one collision law. Fold choice changes disclosed detail and timing only; static and no-JavaScript truth remain identical.

expectedLearning: Whether proof-carrying stage layout plus measured occupancy is sufficient to eliminate crowding without operation specific motion geometry.
allowedWork: Measured stage layout certificates, semantic envelope measurement, responsive fit integration, local compositor occupancy input, one foldable distribution exemplar, bounded canonical lifecycle and motif typing, tests, visual evidence, and Theseus records.
disallowedWork: Second runtime, renderer, compositor, clock, lifecycle category, scheduler category, operation specific coordinates, browser wrapping, glyph text inference, persisted DOM geometry, unrelated deferred work, or user owned dirty files.
